metadata.title: Quad-Grid Pop Portrait with Pastel Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A four-way split grid featuring high-key individual portraits with a central typographic focal point and pastel color grading.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
organic or hand-drawn styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical 2x2 grid of close-up portraits characterized by soft, diffused lighting, pastel-toned hair and makeup, and a central typographic element that bridges the intersection of the four frames.
coreVisualRelationships: Harmonized pastel color palette across disparate subjects
Consistent eye-level perspective in all frames

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects of equal scale, each occupying one quadrant of the frame in a tight headshot or bust-up crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A central rectangular box containing the primary display text, positioned exactly at the cross-section of the grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central text box and moves clockwise through the four portraits, starting from the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space within quadrants; the subjects fill the majority of their respective frames against a neutral wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Soft white and pale grey (backgrounds and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pastel hair colors (mint, lavender, platinum)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low to medium saturation; a 'washed-out' but clean look.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid high-contrast black except for eyeliner/lashes

letterConstructionRules: Inverted or mirrored characters for visual interest
Enclosure within a thin-bordered rectangular frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: Mirrored 'P' or 'R' elements to create symmetry
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif for the brand name paired with a delicate, high-contrast serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Thin rectangular frame around display text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric base for the display text.
Provides the high-contrast elegance for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 2x2 grid of four distinct female portraits with pastel hair (mint, lavender, blonde, brunette), high-key lighting, and neutral backgrounds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central pink rectangular frame. Inside, place bold geometric text with mirrored characters. Below the frame, add a line of spaced-out serif text in the same pink.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting consistent across all four quadrants?
Is the central text box exactly centered?
Are the colors desaturated and pastel?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., mint instead of pink)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the grid lines
Verify skin tones are naturally rendered under high-key light
Check that the central box doesn't obscure vital facial features
Confirm the mirrored characters are intentional and clean
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical 2x2 Portrait Grid + High-Key Pastel Grading + Central Boxed Geometric Typography
